source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U11: Calculate the stipulated default interest on a partner advance

payload.title: Separate an advance from agreed capital
payload.core_explanation_md: Stipulate no contrary contract,a qualifying INR360,000 advance beyond agreed capital and a nine-month period. Apply simple interest at the statutory default6per cent per annum for this exercise.

self_check.prompt_text: Which rule and stipulated facts determine this result?
self_check.expected_takeaway: Use the sourced rule and stated scenario assumptions; the arithmetic does not establish a live legal entitlement.

payload.stem_md: For this exercise,no contrary agreement applies. A partner makes a qualifying INR480,000 advance beyond agreed capital for7months. Apply simple interest at6per cent per annum and enter interest in INR.
payload.correct_explanation_md: 480,000×6/100×7/12=INR16,800. The qualifying advance and absence of a contrary agreement are stipulated.

numeric_rule.rounding_instruction: Use exact whole units; do not round intermediate values.

payload.stem_md: A partner applies the advance-interest default to agreed capital without checking the separate capital-interest rule. Which distinction matters?

options.text_md: Qualifying advances beyond agreed capital and capital contributions have different default treatment
options.explanation_md: Do not apply one financial rule to both categories.

options.text_md: Every capital contribution is automatically an extra advance
A partner may choose any rate retrospectively
Interest calculations determine whether partnership exists

payload.correct_explanation_md: Do not apply one financial rule to both categories.
